title: Spikers' Turf: Alpha Insurance dismisses 3B for third straight win
summary: Alpha Insurance dismissed 3B in straight sets, 25-16, 25-20, 25-22, to continue its winning run in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at the Filoil Centre.
